summary.short: Korea's Telecommunications Business Act (consolidated text; stated effective date 1 October 2026) governs telecom carriers, value-added service providers, app market operators and handset distribution, and is not AI-specific. It sets registration, foreign-ownership, merger and tariff rules, user-protection and anti-discrimination duties, app-market prohibited conduct, and penalties.
summary.long: The Telecommunications Business Act (consolidated text; stated effective date 1 October 2026) governs basic carriers, value-added service providers, app market operators and handset distribution in Korea, and is not AI-specific. Telecom and value-added providers must register or notify (Arts. 6, 22), and certain facility-based carriers face a 49% foreign-ownership cap (Art. 8), public-interest review of certain share acquisitions (Art. 10) and approval of mergers and business transfers (Art. 18). Universal service duties (Art. 4) and tariff filings for designated services (Art. 28) also apply. App market operators must protect users on payments and refunds (Art. 22-9); Art. 50(1)(9) to (11) prohibit forcing a payment method, unduly delaying app review and unduly deleting content. Handset subsidy rules (Arts. 32-11 to 32-16) bar discriminatory subsidies and require cost disclosure. Other provisions cover identity checks for contracts, content blocking for minors (Art. 32-7), removal of illegal filmed material (Art. 22-5) and caller-number spoofing (Art. 84-2). Art. 2-2 reaches conduct abroad affecting the domestic market or users. Enforcement includes corrective orders, licence revocation, surcharges up to 3% of relevant sales (Arts. 52, 53) and criminal penalties (Arts. 94-99).

“이용자”란 전기통신역무를 제공받기 위하여 전기통신사업자와 전기통신역무의 이용에 관한 계약을 체결한 자를 말한다.
“보편적 역무”란 모든 이용자가 언제 어디서나 적절한 요금으로 제공받을 수 있는 기본적인 전기통신역무를 말한다.
